method: the transaction's own preTokenBalances state the authority and the owning token program AT EVENT TIME for every token account the transaction touched; a fetch-time read is compared against them
limits: Only TOKEN accounts are covered: preTokenBalances names the authority and the owning token program. A general account's owner program is not in the transaction metadata and stays a fetch-time fact.
The fetch-time comparison is a LIVE read taken after the event, so a difference is a real skew (the account changed afterwards) — not a rounding or ordering artefact.
One program (Raydium AMM v4) on one date; a sample of that window.

verdict.event_time_authority_free: YES — the transaction metadata states the authority and the owning token program at event time for token accounts reeflog currently drops them for; the fetch-time pass cannot recover them (closed accounts are simply absent now)
